tha-ap469:1.1: Labujadāyaka.] Nagare Bandhumatiyā ārāmiko ahaṃ tadā / addasaṃ virajaṃ Buddhaṃ gacchantam anilañjase. // //
tha-ap469:2.1: Labujaphalam ādāya Buddhasetthass' adās' ahaṃ / ākāse va ṭhito santo patigaṇhi mahāyaso /
tha-ap469:3.1: vittiṃ sañjanano mayhaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhāvaho. // // Phalaṃ Buddhassa datvāna vippasannena cetasā /
tha-ap469:4.1: adhigacchiṃ tadā pūtiṃ vipulaṃ sukham uttamaṃ / uppajjate 'va ratanaṃ nibbattassa yahiṃ yahiṃ. // //
tha-ap469:5.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ phalam adadiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi phaladānass' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap469:9.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Labujadāyako th. i. g. a-ti.
